name: NIH ChestX-ray14
description: A chest radiograph dataset containing 112,120 frontal-view X-ray images from 30,805 patients, annotated with labels for 14 thoracic disease categories. Access is controlled by the NIH; this record does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Wang, X., Peng, Y., Lu, L., Lu, Z., Bagheri, M., & Summers, R. M. (2017). ChestX-ray8: Hospital-scale Chest X-ray Database and Benchmarks on Weakly-Supervised Classification and Localization of Common Thorax Diseases. Proceedings of the IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 2097–2106. https://doi.org/10.1109/CVPR.2017.369
